slides.title: Investment
slides.body: Our all-inclusive programme. beginning at CHF 117,300 per week, is designed to provide complete clinical, therapeutic, and longevity support throughout treatment.

slides.title: Inclusions
slides.body:
- Comprehensive medical and psychiatric assessment
- Bespoke treatment plan
- 24/7 medical and clinical supervision
- One-to-one psychotherapy sessions
- Around the clock support from a dedicated multidisciplinary team
- Ultra luxury private villa overlooking Lake Zurich
- Live-in-counsellor, private chef, chauffeur, housekeeping, personal trainer, nutrionists and more
- All meals and nutritional planning
- Holistic and complementary therapies
- Regenerative Aesthetics Assessment
- Fitness, movement, wellness and leisure activities
- Limousine service to all appointments
- Ongoing case management and coordination of care
- Family support and involvement as needed
- Aftercare planning and recommendations
